The leave are made of silk, and the stems are made of iron wire wrapped with plastic, so the branch can be twisted into different shapes.
They looks natural, life-like and vivid realistic, just look like real one.
It is great for party , office decoration ,decor, altar, church,corsages, pew bows, or as a gift for your family.
Eucalyptus Leaf Sprays can be placed anywhere. Squashing them is not a problem.
